prompt:
New ordinary WALKING animation drawing pair at the EXACT same NATIVE CHARACTER SCALE as the reference: about 1150 pixels high from hair to grounded sole, same head height. 1205x1305 portrait canvas. Full pure green margin at outer edges. RIGHT drawing MUST be shifted toward the middle, center its head at x820 not x950. Its rightmost toe MUST stop before x1150. Keep compact bent knees, shorten forward stride. Both heads strict screen-right side profile with one eye.
Use case: identity-preserve. Production animation pose pair.
Exactly TWO separate full-body animation drawings side by side in one portrait image, aspect 1205:1305. Two equal vertical cells. LEFT drawing body center at x=260, RIGHT drawing body center at x=820. Shift BOTH figures toward the LEFT so their forward toes have lots of space to the RIGHT. Keep an empty green gap. Keep all hair, hands, clothing and accessories inside each cell, with an empty green gap between them. Full native detail, about 1000 pixels figure height, no thumbnail sheet. Neutral standing boots at y=1200, top of hair around y=180. Preserve this scale for EVERY pose; crouching is shorter, jumping is displaced upward, never zoom a pose to fill its cell. Flat pure chroma green RGB(0,255,0), no floor, cast shadow, gradient, green reflection, checkerboard, writing, symbols, UI, bubbles, watermarks or extra figures. Opaque character with crisp fine cel-shaded outlines, polished eyes, accurate hands, coherent hair locks and fabric folds. Left and right images are two successive ANIMATION DRAWINGS of the SAME identity and outfit, not different costume designs.
Fan-made March 7th chibi. Redraw in refined high-detail anime cel animation, about 3 heads tall. Pink bob haircut with pale highlights, bright blue-pink eyes, cheerful inquisitive expression, small icy flower hair ornament. Preserve the supplied existing pet identity; reference is for outfit and colors only, NOT its repeated static poses. Genuine new hand, leg, face and hair drawings in each frame.
OUTFIT IN BOTH CELLS: Signature blue and pale-pink adventurer outfit with white blouse, short layered blue skirt, blue-pink jacket, small hanging camera and strap, pale stockings and blue ankle shoes. Keep the same outfit in ALL states; no lab coat.
LEFT CELL: RIGHT profile WALK PASSING pose: left support leg STRAIGHT VERTICALLY directly under hips. Right thigh raised FORWARD to the RIGHT, right knee ahead of the body, right shin vertical and right boot dangling UNDER that forward knee. Both arms nearly vertical passing the hips. NOT a wide stride, NOT a heel curled behind. Support foot planted. Draw this precise new leg pose, not reference legs.
RIGHT CELL: RIGHT profile WALK UP pose: left support ankle on toe directly under hips, right knee and right boot AHEAD of the torso to the RIGHT, right shin starts extending toward next contact, boot still airborne. Right arm swings slightly backward, left arm forward. Torso rises slightly, hair and hem trail left. NO rear heel curl, no wide grounded stride.
BOTH heads strictly RIGHT-facing SIDE PROFILE: one visible eye, nose points horizontally RIGHT. Never rotate face toward viewer; keep reference profile head and torso angle identical. Draw the specified changing limbs only.
Only these two poses. Do not reuse identical neutral standing art for active poses. Precise same head size, leg length, eye shape and hair silhouette. Never add failure X marks, wave lines or a visible keyboard.
